## 🔄 What is a looped transformer?

A standard transformer stacks *L* distinct layers. A **looped** (a.k.a. *recurrent-depth*, *universal*,
*weight-tied* or *recursive*) transformer instead applies **one shared block (or a small stack) R times**,
feeding its output back in as input. Depth becomes a knob you can turn at inference time, parameters stay
fixed, and the model can "think longer" in its hidden state instead of in generated tokens.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    x([input tokens]) --> P[Prelude<br/>embed + few layers]
    P --> B
    subgraph loop [" repeat R times (fixed, sampled, or adaptive) "]
        B[Shared transformer block<br/>same weights every pass] -->|hidden state| B
    end
    B --> C[Coda<br/>few layers + head]
    C --> y([output])
```

This list tracks the whole family: the original **Universal Transformer**, the **theory** of what loops can
express, **algorithmic and latent reasoning** (HRM, TRM, Deep Thinking), **looped LLMs** at scale (Huginn,
Ouro, Mixture-of-Recursions), **adaptive depth**, **compression** of pretrained models into recursive
ones, **looped diffusion and vision** backbones, and their infinite-depth cousins, **deep equilibrium
models**.

## 🧰 Resources

### Code & Libraries

- [ANIRA](https://github.com/merlresearch/ANIRA) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/merlresearch/ANIRA?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/merlresearch/ANIRA) <sub>(2026-02)</sub>: Controlled recurrent-transformer framework for studying per-token dynamic compute allocation.
- [Deep Equilibrium Models](https://github.com/locuslab/deq) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/locuslab/deq?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/locuslab/deq) <sub>(2019-09)</sub>: Official DEQ code for fixed-point weight-tied models with implicit differentiation.
- [deep-thinking](https://github.com/aks2203/deep-thinking) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/aks2203/deep-thinking?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/aks2203/deep-thinking) <sub>(2022-02)</sub>: Deep Thinking networks with recall and progressive loss for easy-to-hard extrapolation in recurrent networks.
- [HRM](https://github.com/sapientinc/HRM) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/sapientinc/HRM?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/sapientinc/HRM) <sub>(2025-06)</sub>: Official implementation of the Hierarchical Reasoning Model with released Sudoku, maze and ARC checkpoints.
- [HRM analysis (ARC Prize)](https://github.com/arcprize/hierarchical-reasoning-model-analysis) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/arcprize/hierarchical-reasoning-model-analysis?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/arcprize/hierarchical-reasoning-model-analysis) <sub>(2025-08)</sub>: ARC Prize ablation code used to replicate HRM and isolate what drives its ARC-AGI performance.
- [huginn-latent-cot](https://github.com/wenquanlu/huginn-latent-cot) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/wenquanlu/huginn-latent-cot?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/wenquanlu/huginn-latent-cot) <sub>(2025-07)</sub>: Probing code (logit lens, coda lens, rank trajectories) for decoding latent reasoning in Huginn.
- [Loop-Think-Generalize](https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/Loop-Think-Generalize) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/OSU-NLP-Group/Loop-Think-Generalize?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/Loop-Think-Generalize) <sub>(2026-04)</sub>: Code for studying implicit multi-hop reasoning and depth extrapolation in recurrent-depth transformers.
- [Looped-GPT](https://github.com/sanyalsunny111/Looped-GPT) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/sanyalsunny111/Looped-GPT?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/sanyalsunny111/Looped-GPT) <sub>(2026-01)</sub>: Minimal, hackable nanoGPT-style implementation for pretraining looped GPT models.
- [looped-lm-scaling](https://github.com/kschwethelm/looped-lm-scaling) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kschwethelm/looped-lm-scaling?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/kschwethelm/looped-lm-scaling) <sub>(2026-04)</sub>: Code and checkpoints for iso-depth scaling laws of looped language models.
- [looped_transformer](https://github.com/leiay/looped_transformer) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/leiay/looped_transformer?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/leiay/looped_transformer) <sub>(2023-11)</sub>: Code for looped transformers that learn in-context learning algorithms with input injection.
- [LoopFormer](https://github.com/armenjeddi/loopformer) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/armenjeddi/loopformer?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/armenjeddi/loopformer) <sub>(2026-02)</sub>: Official code for elastic-depth looped transformers trained with shortcut modulation.
- [loopscape](https://github.com/GilpinLab/loopscape) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/GilpinLab/loopscape?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/GilpinLab/loopscape) <sub>(2026-09)</sub>: Tools for probing fractal convergence basins of recurrent reasoning models such as looped transformers and TRM-style solvers.
- [Mixture-of-Recursions](https://github.com/raymin0223/mixture_of_recursions) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/raymin0223/mixture_of_recursions?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/raymin0223/mixture_of_recursions) <sub>(2025-07)</sub>: Official implementation of Mixture-of-Recursions, which routes tokens to different recursion depths of a shared block.

- [recurrent-pretraining (Huginn)](https://github.com/seal-rg/recurrent-pretraining) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/seal-rg/recurrent-pretraining?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/seal-rg/recurrent-pretraining) <sub>(2025-02)</sub>: Official pretraining and inference code for the Huginn-0125 recurrent-depth language model trained on Frontier.
- [retrofitting-recurrence](https://github.com/mcleish7/retrofitting-recurrence) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/mcleish7/retrofitting-recurrence?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/mcleish7/retrofitting-recurrence) <sub>(2025-11)</sub>: Code for converting pretrained language models into depth-recurrent models with a recurrence curriculum.
- [Sparse Universal Transformer](https://github.com/shawntan/SUT) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/shawntan/SUT?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/shawntan/SUT) <sub>(2023-10)</sub>: Implementation of Sparse Universal Transformers with stick-breaking halting for machine translation.
- [Tensor2Tensor (Universal Transformer)](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/tensorflow/tensor2tensor?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor): Google library containing the original Universal Transformer implementation.
- [Think-at-Hard (TaH)](https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/thu-nics/TaH?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH) <sub>(2025-11)</sub>: Official code for Think-at-Hard, which selectively applies extra latent iterations only to hard tokens.
- [TinyRecursiveModels (TRM)](https://github.com/SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels) <sub>(2025-10)</sub>: Official code for Tiny Recursive Models, a two-layer network applied recursively for puzzle reasoning.
- [utm-jax](https://github.com/che-shr-cat/utm-jax) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/che-shr-cat/utm-jax?style=flat&logo=github&label=&color=4c1)](https://github.com/che-shr-cat/utm-jax) <sub>(2026-04)</sub>: JAX/Flax Universal Transformer with memory tokens and ACT for studying depth-state trade-offs.

### Open Checkpoints

- [HRM checkpoint (ARC-2)](https://huggingface.co/sapientinc/HRM-checkpoint-ARC-2): Released Hierarchical Reasoning Model checkpoint for ARC-AGI-2.
- [Huginn-0125](https://huggingface.co/tomg-group-umd/huginn-0125) <sub>(2025-02)</sub>: 3.5B-parameter recurrent-depth language model trained on 800B tokens with test-time adjustable recurrence.
- [Ouro-1.4B](https://huggingface.co/ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B) <sub>(2025-10)</sub>: ByteDance Seed 1.4B looped language model pretrained on 7.7T tokens; a Thinking variant is also released.
- [Ouro-2.6B](https://huggingface.co/ByteDance/Ouro-2.6B) <sub>(2025-10)</sub>: ByteDance Seed 2.6B looped language model with shared recurrent layers and learned early exit; a Thinking variant is also released.
- [Retrofitted recurrence models](https://huggingface.co/collections/tomg-group-umd/retrofitting-recurrence) <sub>(2025-11)</sub>: Collection of pretrained LMs converted into depth-recurrent models.
- [TaH-plus-1.7B](https://huggingface.co/nics-efc/TaH-plus-1.7B) <sub>(2025-11)</sub>: Qwen3-1.7B-based model that iterates latently only on hard tokens.

### Blog Posts

- [Adaptive Computation Time (ACT) in Neural Networks [3/3]](https://moocaholic.medium.com/adaptive-computation-time-act-in-neural-networks-3-3-99452b2eff18) <sub>(2020-01)</sub>: Reviews ACT in transformers, including Universal Transformers with per-position halting and ALBERT-style sharing.
- [Exact Input Writes Improve Stable Looped Language Models](https://huskydoge.github.io/husky-blog/posts/recursive_models/improve-parcae/) <sub>(2026-04)</sub>: Proposes an exact zero-order-hold input write for Parcae-style looped LMs and reports lower validation loss.
- [Loop-Model FLOPs and Memory in an Ablation Chain](https://huskydoge.github.io/husky-blog/posts/recursive_models/loop-cost/) <sub>(2026-04)</sub>: Walks through FLOPs and memory costs of loop-model training choices such as weight sharing, detach and truncation.
- [Looped-GPT: Looping During Pre-training improves Generalization](https://sanyalsunny111.github.io/posts/2026-01-15-post1-looped-gpt/) <sub>(2026-01)</sub>: Blog post reporting that looped GPT pretraining improves generalization under matched parameters and FLOPs.
- [The Hidden Drivers of HRM's Performance on ARC-AGI](https://arcprize.org/blog/hrm-analysis) <sub>(2025-08)</sub>: ARC Prize analysis finding that HRM's outer refinement loop and augmentation, not its hierarchy, drive its ARC results.
- [Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I](https://ifm-research.notion.site/Towards-Looped-Models-Done-Right-3ade511912ec8128987dfeb7a5580043) <sub>(2026-07)</sub>: Compute-matched ablations of loop topology, input injection and recurrent-state design for looped LMs.

## 🤝 Contributing

Contributions are very welcome, and the fastest path is fully automated:

1. **[Open an "Add a paper" issue](https://github.com/shreshthsaini/Rough-Claude-Cloud/issues/new?template=add-paper.yml)**
   and paste an arXiv link. Everything else is optional.
2. A bot fetches the **title, authors, date, venue and code link** from arXiv, files it in the category you
   picked, regenerates this README, and **opens a pull request** for you.
3. A maintainer reviews and merges. Done.

Maintainers can also add a paper from any issue or PR comment with
`/add-paper <arxiv-id-or-url> <category> [type]`. A weekly job scans arXiv for new looped-transformer papers
and opens a triage issue with candidates.

Prefer editing by hand? Add an entry to [`data/papers.yaml`](data/papers.yaml) and open a PR; CI
validates it and the README is rebuilt on merge. See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)** for the field
reference and inclusion criteria.
